EX-99.1 2 gmab_20261023xex99d1.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Genmab Announces Rinatabart Sesutecan (Rina-S ® ) Demonstrates Statistically Significant Improvement in Progression-Free Survival and Overall Survival in Patients with Platinum-Resistant Ovarian Cancer Company Announcement COPENHAGEN, Denmark; October 23, 2026 • Phase 3 RAINFOL™-02 trial met its primary endpoint of progression-free survival (PFS) and its key secondary endpoint of overall survival (OS) with rinatabart sesutecan (Rina-S ® ) compared to investigator’s choice chemotherapy • Results demonstrated statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in PFS and OS in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer (PROC) • Data will be submitted for presentation at a future medical meeting and discussed with regulatory authorities worldwide Genmab A/S (Nasdaq: GMAB) announced today positive topline results from the global Phase 3 RAINFOL™-02 trial of rinatabart sesutecan (Rina-S ® ), an investigational folate receptor alpha (FRα)-targeted, topoisomerase I (TOPO1)-inhibitor antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer (PROC) regardless of FRα expression level or prior treatment with mirvetuximab .

“As the first Phase 3 readout from our Rina-S program, the positive topline results from RAINFOL-02 mark a significant milestone for Genmab and strengthen our confidence in Rina-S’s potential for patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.
